page.overview:
Who is Kelly Curtis?

Kelly Curtis was a seventh-grade student at Woodside Junior High. She was thirteen years old and the best and only friend of Arby Benton. She appeared only in The Lost World.

Kelly grew up in a single-parent family with an unreliable mother who allowed her only to wear her older sister Emily's hand-me-downs and had to take care of herself. She likes mathematics, much to her mother's displeasure. Other students tease her, such as Allison Stone. Her only friend at high school is Arby Benton. She idolizes Sarah Harding.

Both Kelly and Arby worked odd jobs for Richard Levine, who was working as their teacher as part of his court order. Originally, both Kelly and Arby were allowed and prepared to go on a field trip during school break to test out a large range of equipment that Levine had ordered from Jack “Doc” Thorne. However, they were disappointed to find that the testing session was cancelled. Not wanting to be left out of finding Levine, who had gone missing, both kids stowed away in the field trailers that were destined for Isla Sorna.

Originally, Kelly enjoyed the sight of the dinosaurs, but then became fearful of them after witnessing the power of the Tyrannosaurus rexes and Velociraptors. During a raptor attack on the high hide, Arby was locked in the predator cage. Kelly was the only person that saw the key to the cage had been taken by one individual raptor, and rode with Sarah Harding on a motorcycle to kill it. She killed the raptor by shooting it with a Lindstradt rifle containing darts made with enhanced cone snail venom, and later saved Levine from another raptor by shooting it as well. She further helped Harding find a Cholinesterase Bomb in the last trailer which Harding used against some raptors. Later in the store, Kelly located a service tunnel that led to an escape from the attacking raptors, saving everyone from certain death. She escaped the island on a boat with the rest of the survivors.
